title: Flipidippi SMP
description: Flipidippi SMP ist an NEW SMP Server. The Mods don't change the Game much.
body:
Welcome to Flipidippi SMP

Flipidippi SMP is a vanilla-friendly Minecraft survival server focused on building, exploration, and community.

Features
🎤 Proximity Voice Chat
😀 Emotes with Emotecraft
👕 Custom player skins
🤝 Friendly community
🏠 Long-term survival world
⚡ Lightweight modpack
Server Information

The server is currently private and under development.

Public access, the server IP, and the Discord invite will be available once the server officially launches.

Thank you for your interest!
